policy_presence.summary: U-M publishes institution-level principles and course/college authority. LSA procedures, ITS terms and School of Nursing guidance apply within their own scopes.

coursework.summary: The instructor determines permitted GenAI uses by course, assessment and activity, aligned with college misconduct policy. Read the syllabus and task instructions. Published permitted/restricted/banned examples are templates, not universal campus rules.

exams.summary: Follow the specific exam and college instructions. Current recaptured guidance establishes assessment-level instructor authority, but no exact exam authorization was revalidated. The Rackham explicit-permission claim remains held after source-access failure.

ai_disclosure.summary: University principles call for appropriate disclosure and citation. Follow the actual course’s rules; sample disclosure appendices or bans are not automatically mandatory throughout U-M.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Use approved services and check each permitted data type; external services without a U-M contract should receive only Low institutional data. No model training does not mean no prompt/history/log processing or vendor sharing. Uniform retention duration and authenticated sensitive-data matrices remain unresolved.

academic_integrity.summary: LSA distinguishes Instructor and SAA Resolution, presumes no responsibility while pending, and permits a response/support person. Course and college outcomes differ. LSA appeal is two weeks from the resolution-letter date. Rackham’s separate clock is not substituted; detector output is inquiry, not proof.

approved_tools.summary: ITS offers U-M GPT, Maizey and GPT Toolkit for active U-M users, subject to U.S.-only terms. Google eligibility excludes sponsored affiliates, alumni and retirees. Tool access, data approval and assessment permission are separate.

named_ai_services.summary: The six retained institutional offerings include Google Gemini Notebook, the current name for NotebookLM, and enterprise Adobe Firefly. The external-tools list is informational and is not an endorsement.

teaching_guidance.summary: U-M does not recommend unreliable AI detectors; this is not a ban. Instructors should make course rules clear. School of Nursing guidance says AI should not be the sole grading basis and identifiable student work needs approved service/use; do not extend this unit rule campus-wide.

research_guidance.summary: Apply honesty, appropriate citation and human responsibility in research. OVPR discourages GenAI peer reviewing and strongly discourages commercial upload of another researcher’s grant application. Its secure-tool language/clarity exception and sponsor conditions remain. HRPP/Rackham-specific claims are held.

security_procurement.summary: Human-review AI-generated code; use professionally trained peer review for all new/significantly changed applications, especially High/Restricted data. Procurement Services should be the sole buyer for institutional AI handling Moderate/High/Restricted data. Per-service approval remains separate.
